histories.name: new-good-path
histories.note: New card through the learning steps, then on-time reviews.

histories.name: new-easy
histories.note: Easy on a new card skips the learning steps.

histories.name: learning-again-hard
histories.note: Again and Hard inside the learning steps (Hard at step 0 = 5.5 min, at step 1 = 10 min).

histories.name: lapse-relearn
histories.note: A lapse, then Hard (15 min) and Again inside relearning, then back to review.

histories.name: same-day-reviews
histories.note: Short-term stability for same-day reviews in review and relearning.

histories.name: overdue-and-forgotten
histories.note: Reviewed 60 days late, then forgotten after 200 days.

histories.name: early-review
histories.note: Reviews well before the due date.

histories.name: learning-next-day
histories.note: A learning card reviewed two days later uses the long-term update.

histories.name: new-again-days-later
histories.note: Again on a new card, then three days later.

histories.name: hard-chain
histories.note: Hard on time: difficulty climbs toward 10.

histories.name: easy-chain
histories.note: Easy on time: difficulty falls to 1, intervals grow.

histories.name: again-chain
histories.note: Repeated lapses: difficulty to 10, stability shrinks.

histories.name: clock-skew
histories.note: A review stamped an hour before the last one (negative elapsed time).
